vcu_g_0159_2000329c.name: adc_avg_result_0
vcu_g_0159_2000329c.description: Element 0 of the five 16-bit ADC channel averages (raw 12-bit ADC counts, 0..4095). vcu_adc_average_16_scans writes it as (sum of 16 scans >> 4) through a (short) cast, and app_get_u16_2000329c returns it to the application (probably the sampled analog input of one sensor). Elements 1..4 at 0x2000329e..0x200032a5 are described as adc_avg_result_1_4 in data_app_batch03; together they form one five-element result array.

vcu_g_0159_200032a6.name: adc_dma_scan0
vcu_g_0159_200032a6.description: Scan 0 of the ADC1 DMA result buffer: five raw 12-bit conversion results (halfwords) that DMA1 channel 1 writes from the ADC1 data register. In every build the buffer starts here; in builds 148, 14a, 14b and 14e it is only this one 5-halfword scan (single-shot transfer), while build 0159 runs it as an 80-halfword circular ring (see adc_dma_scans_1_15). vcu_adc_average_16_scans reads it each time it runs. The family 0x200032a8 is channel 1 of this scan.

vcu_g_0159_200032b0.name: adc_dma_scans_1_15
vcu_g_0159_200032b0.description: Scans 1..15 of the 80-halfword circular ADC1 DMA buffer (build 0159 only; vcu_adc_dma_ring_init sets the ring to 0x50 halfwords, circular mode). Each scan is five halfwords, one per channel, in regular-sequence order. vcu_adc_average_16_scans sums all 16 scans per channel and writes the means to adc_avg_result_0..4. The family 0x200032b0 is channel 0 of scan 1.
